Add and remove rows in Shiny

Source: R/row-actions.R
reactable-row-actions.Rd

Enable row controls with reactable(rowActions = list(add = TRUE, remove = TRUE)). getReactableRowAction() returns the latest action reactively. An "add" event requests a complete new row from the server. Reply using addReactableRow(), passing its requestId. An optional error reports failure instead of inserting a row. A "remove" event reports a row already removed in the browser after user confirmation. The application must enforce permissions and persist all changes in its authoritative data.

Usage

getReactableRowAction(outputId, session = NULL)

addReactableRow(
  outputId,
  data = NULL,
  inputIds = NULL,
  requestId = NULL,
  error = NULL,
  session = NULL
)

Arguments

outputId

The Shiny output ID of the reactable instance.

session

The Shiny session. Defaults to the current reactive domain.

data

A complete one-row data frame or matrix with the same columns as the current data, including a new, unique stable row key. The server generates this key.

inputIds

Optional named character vector or named list of input IDs indexed by column ID. Overrides apply to editable cells; other cells receive default IDs. IDs are automatically namespaced inside Shiny modules.

requestId

The "add" action's request ID. Use NULL for a server-initiated append.

error

A nonempty failure message instead of adding data. Requires requestId.

Value

getReactableRowAction() returns NULL before the first action, or a list containing action and requestId. Removal also includes rowId and data (the removed record). addReactableRow() returns invisibly.

Details

Added rows appear in a separate section at the bottom of every page, outside sorting, filtering, grouping, and pagination until the next complete data replacement. Use updateReactable(data = ...) to integrate additions into the regular table. Full replacement invalidates pending add requests; late replies to those requests are ignored. This feature requires Shiny, stable row keys, client-side processing, and no .subRows or Crosstalk data.
